name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Creates and submits expense claims, lists the caller's own claims, lists and decides a manager's team claims.

dependencies.name: receipt-reader
dependencies.description: Extracts merchant, date and total from an uploaded receipt photo/PDF, and flags gambling/betting receipts, before the employee submits a claim.

description: The single-page app every Employee and Manager signs into. Employees upload receipts, review/correct the extracted data, add a note, and submit claims, and track their own claims' status. Managers additionally see their direct reports' claims and approve or reject each one. Holds no business data of its own — every read and write goes through expense-api or receipt-reader.
